purpose: Bounded attention-plus-Mamba real-data probe after the rejected all-nine-module follow-up. This experiment tests behavioral movement only; it is not a deployable or promoted checkpoint.
hypothesis: A lower-rate adapter on attention and Mamba input/output projections will move behavior while reducing drift relative to the rejected 3e-5 all-nine-module run.

execution.precision: plain FP16 LoRA; no QLoRA on P100

data.public_data_policy: MCQA built from public train splits only; final holdout was not read

training_result.checkpoint_persistence: Ephemeral Kaggle working-directory run by design; no adapter or checkpoint was promoted or downloaded
training_result.behavioral_movement: PASS; adapter changed 6 of 16 development/validation generations

mechanical_quality_rubric.rubric_source: quality fields embedded in development/validation batteries; frozen final gate was not run

generation_behavior.qualitative_observation: The adapter changed token sequences but retained malformed Kiswahili, weak clinical dispositions, and fabricated WHO/Grade-Blue protocol behavior. The changed outputs were not a useful safety improvement.

evaluation.promotion: REJECTED; dev and validation quality gates failed

diagnosis.pipeline_movement: PASS; the lower-rate six-module adapter changed 6/16 generations and reduced SFT dev loss by 0.031897, but did not move MCQA.
diagnosis.quality_result: FAIL; development remained 0/8 and validation remained 2/8, with the same critical safety/hallucination failures as stock on the scored batteries.
diagnosis.primary_next_diagnosis: Data/teacher-answer quality, bilingual formatting, and base-model capability remain the leading constraints; optimizer attachment is not the leading explanation.
not_authorized: GGUF export as a submission candidate
diagnosis.next_action: FOLLOW-UP only through data and evaluation correction: inspect the malformed bilingual examples and teacher outputs, improve the development rubric, and test prompt/format/data interventions cheaply before any longer training.
known_limits: The 25-row MCQA slice is directional only.
No frozen final holdout was read.
The probe used an ephemeral Kaggle workspace and intentionally did not create a durable candidate.
Generation evaluation used the 51-token stock system prompt; no system prompt candidate has passed selection.
P100 used the naive Mamba implementation; this is not a deployment-throughput claim.

artifacts.local_weight_policy: Only small JSON/log summaries were retrieved locally; adapter, optimizer, and model files were not downloaded
